additional_info.subject: ID0386905-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / R4 170001749] Error on IMD CRM:00642001705
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
Hope you are doing great.
It seems like Communication error between IMD and PLC. We request you to please go through the below process.
Issue                                                                                                                                       Root Cause                                     Solution
Error-flags:
IMD_BC1 and/or IMD_BC2
(MB-Er:0 IsoWarn/Fail/PEConn:0 Capa:0 RlyConn:0 Init:0 SIS:0)
communication error
check the wiring of the communication bus (green,red, black) between all the BC, to the XD10.1A, XD10.1B and KF11
check for a shortage between the A, B, PE
check resistance and test with bypass
check the configuration on the Bender (-BC1 & -BC2 & ...)
Please find below knowledge article link for your reference.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_IMD BC_Chargingstation OOO -
